configuration: r838 local module, not full reactor
mask_rule: relative statistical standard error above0.5 or zero mean; no measurement uncertainty included
source_run_issues: First cosine/rear tallies retained; tracks recovered in a one-batch companion with unchanged physics and seed after correcting the track API spelling. New profile-derived cases use two finite independently resampled source banks. Module tallies combine both banks, displayed paths are from bank0.
visual_encodings: Metres-to-centimetres already converted in solver geometry; coordinates are cm. Unreal flips Y to account for handedness.
Particle markers and brightness are illustrative; positions/time/energy are actual recorded histories.
Independent first16 histories share emission time for display; not a physical pulse or source intensity.
Time slider is logarithmic. Field colors use one common log(1+value) scale with actual displayed units.
Cutaway hides surfaces for inspection; it does not alter transport geometry.

source_context.scope: Reproduced r838 profiles, parameterized direct-view source. Not measured equilibrium or whole-device neutron transport.

limits: Uncollided source only: no return flux, surrounding blanket transport, ports or divertor source.
Source geometry is an explicit parameterized proxy, not transport-ready reactor CAD.
Scalar neutron rate can be normalized to the reproduced DT reaction rate, but whole-reactor TBR and electric output are not calculated.
Source Monte Carlo/integration checks do not include nuclear-data, equilibrium or physical-model uncertainty.
OpenMC may recycle a finite equal-weight source bank; finite-bank sensitivity retained separately.
No original approved input or completed study is overwritten.

authoritative_local_input.admission: Does spatial placement of the actual proposed header inventory change local triton yield or heating enough to invalidate the uniform-material approximation? No full reactor TBR or net-power claim.
authoritative_local_input.boundary: reflecting y/z faces, vacuum front/back; local repeated rectangular representative cell, no toroidal return flux
authoritative_local_input.decision_rule: Flag geometry sensitivity when absolute yield difference exceeds2% of homogeneous and independent-run99% normal Monte Carlo interval excludeszero. No physical uncertainty/validation claim.
limitations: Not transport-ready full reactor CAD or globalTBR.
Identical per-nuclide inventories across layouts; fixed uniform temperatures, no thermal expansion or CFD feedback.
No moderator bound-atom S(alpha,beta) data assigned to ceramic or TiBe12; model-form and nuclear-data uncertainty excluded.
Front-header layout is a stress case, not a claimed optimized manifold or safe pressure vessel.
Published benchmark validates only scope actually reproduced, not candidate tritium performance.
authoritative_local_input.material_recipe: NMM1.2.3 eurofer recipe overridden to pinned7.8g/cm3; solids use PROCESS effective densities. Isotopic and temperature assumptions are diagnostic, not validated blanket specification.
authoritative_local_input.reuse: Unchanged Oktavian Al reference, OpenMC transport and existing material recipe. No new blanket optimizer.

visualization.selection: Display-only evenly spaced indices across the complete equal-weight source banks. Full particles, weights and source observations remain stored. No analysis uses the display subset.
